result.title: HiP3R: Hierarchical Pose Graphs for Long-Horizon 3D Reconstruction
result.summary: Feed-forward models accurately estimate camera motion and 3D geometry from short video windows. However, computational and memory costs prevent direct inference on sequences containing thousands of frames. Long videos must therefore be processed as overlapping chunks. This division produces independent local reconstructions with inconsistent coordinate frames and duplicate estimates of shared cameras. Achieving global consistency requires propagating constraints from adjacent overlaps and distant revisits across the sequence. This requirement naturally motivates pose graph optimization. However, the choice of graph level creates a trade-off. Chunk-level graphs efficiently resolve scale drift and close large loops. Yet, their rigid transformations cannot correct internal errors or conflicting frame predictions. Conversely, frame-level optimization offers local flexibility, but scaling it globally is computationally expensive and can break metric scale. HiP3R resolves this trade-off using a hierarchical pose graph. HiP3R first optimizes a robust chunk-level $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ graph to establish the global layout and scale. It then holds this layout fixed and estimates one shared $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ camera per frame, turning overlapping window predictions into a single trajectory. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of HiP3R in improving camera trajectories and 3D reconstruction. Our method applies to both chunk-based and streaming backends without additional training or fine-tuning. The codes are available at https://kkakkkka.github.io/HiP3R.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 HiP3R，用于长时长视频的三维重建：先优化 chunk 级 Sim(3) pose graph 以确定全局布局与尺度，再固定该布局、逐帧估计共享的 SE(3) 相机位姿，从而把重叠窗口的局部重建统一为单一轨迹；方法无需额外训练即可套用于 chunk 式与流式后端。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「全局刚性布局固定、局部逐帧状态细化」的分层状态组织，可能与 LVR 中多层级 latent 工作区（粗粒度全局约束与细粒度状态更新的分工、漂移与一致性控制）存在类比，可供核查；但原文面向几何重建，与推理过程没有直接联系。
